annotations.title: Add a document to a site

description: One file held on a site and read, as a file dropped on the site's page is: its text layer page by page, its summary and, for a laboratory table, its result rows, all kept in the account and searched by ask_site. Give the file as `content_base64`, or a text as `text`. The same bytes added twice are one document. The answer gives the document's id, its state (read, or refused with a code and why), its pages, and `not_done`: each step of the read not made in this call. At most 8 MiB a file here; a larger one goes on the site's page (up to 200 MiB).

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64. Give this or `text`.

filename.description: The file's name with its extension (permit.pdf, results.xlsx, notes.txt): it says what kind of file it is.

site.description: The site: its id (from list_sites), or a part of its name that names one site only.

text.description: The document as text, kept as a UTF-8 file under `filename`. Give this or `content_base64`.

name: add_document
